description: Analyse a 'sell one, buy two' plan where two co-owners sell their joint home. Returns the sale proceeds (cash after loan, CPF refunds, SSD and legal fees) and each buyer's resulting cash and CPF. With `buy1`, it compares buying one replacement jointly or under either buyer alone; with `buy2Property1` and `buy2Property2`, each buyer buying one property (both pairings). Every option is given at 30- and 35-year tenures with max loan, LTV, instalment, downpayment, stamp duties, cash/CPF shortfalls, TDSR used and an affordability verdict.

buy1.description: The single property in the "buy one" scenario.

legalFees.description: Conveyancing fees for buying this property, in SGD; part of the cash required.

loanInterestRate.description: Annual rate assumed for this loan, as a percentage (e.g. 2.6 = 2.6%); sets the instalment. Affordability is tested at the higher of this and the MAS 4% floor.

propertyPrice.description: Price of the property to buy, in SGD; loan, downpayment and stamp duties follow from it.

remainingLeaseYears.description: Remaining lease in years; omit for freehold. When the lease will not last until the youngest buyer turns 95, the CPF usable on this property is prorated (none below 20 years).

minCashDownpayment.description: Part of the downpayment left to pay in cash after CPF is applied, in SGD.

tdsrUsed.description: Stress-tested instalment as a percentage of the 55% TDSR income cap, before other debts (100 = cap fully used).
